evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 汇芳书院
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鴻慈永祜東垣外徑連岡三重度橋而東則彚芳書院也内宇為抒藻軒後為涵逺齋齋前西垣内為翠照樓東垣内為倬雲樓又東為眉月軒倬雲樓南稍東為隨安室又東敞宇三楹為問津逾溪橋數武有石坊為斷橋殘雪（圓明園册）臣等謹按彚芳書院四十景之一額為皇上御書倬雲樓中楹額曰竹深荷淨與院内諸額皆御書涵逺齋内聨曰寳案凝香圖書陳道法仙臺麗景晴雨驗耕桑亦御書問津額為世宗御書
evidence.summary: East of the wall of 鴻慈永祜, over three ridges: 彚芳書院 with 抒藻軒, 涵逺齋, 翠照樓, 倬雲樓, 眉月軒, 隨安室, the three-bay 問津, and a stone arch 斷橋殘雪 beyond a footbridge.

evidence.title: 倬云楼: 乾隆三十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十九年 (1774), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 总在一区书院中，安名立字各无同。倬云若问即景句，幸释宣忧赖化工。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 倬云楼, 1774, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 倬云楼: 乾隆五十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆五十八年 (1793), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 齐云王氏记曾提，（齐云楼见王禹，偁黄冈竹楼记。楼在苏州府，丁丑南巡杂咏，吴下古迹曾有诗。）是倬无心用拟题。（御园中诸题率皆用，内廷翰林所拟。）历久已忘如忽耳，即今偶见乃夔兮。白诗晚寄潇而洒，周雅旱同咨与赍。此际初春胥异彼，聊因七字寓闲跻。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 倬云楼, 1793, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 倬云楼
evidence.locator: from p.211, under 汇芳书院
evidence.summary: 倬云楼: 2 dated items, 1774-1793, of which 2 poems (Qianlong); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1774, last dated 1793.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 汇芳书院
evidence.summary: Of 1742, in the form of an academy: a five-bay gate, 抒藻轩 with a three-bay annex, 涵远斋 of five, 翠照轩, 倬云楼, the crescent 眉月轩 of nine bays, 随安室, 挹秀亭, 延赏亭, 问津, the 断桥残雪 arch, 秀云亭.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label, 9x1 cells: a building stood here, its name unknown.
